intro: I'm a Software Engineer with a deep passion for mobile, desktop and web development. I am American, currently based in Mexico.
My main focus is to improve the way people interact with technology, creating better experiences and helping to improve the future using software as my main tool.
You can have a look at my work here.
about: I’m a Mexican-American full-stack software engineer with 3+ years of experience building production web and mobile software. I work primarily with C#/.NET, React, and modern web technologies, and I enjoy building scalable systems, APIs, and data-driven applications.

My interest in technology started early through experimenting with smartphones and operating systems, which led me to attend a technical high school where I first learned C++ and SQL. That curiosity eventually turned into a career in software development.
Today I focus on building reliable systems that solve real-world problems, and I’m always interested in learning new technologies when a problem requires it.
